    Add Let's Encrypt DNS-01 cert issuance/deployment playbook
    
    issue-deploy-certs.yml issues/renews certs for the domains in

    ssh_zonefile (manual zone-file editing over SSH for ns1, which has
    neither TSIG nor an API) — plus an ad-hoc mode that auto-discovers
    the owning ns1 zone for a one-off domain not in the catalogue.

    explicitly overridden.
